verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of agent skill files (SKILL.md prompts) installed into a repo or plugin marketplace. It is not a service with an HTTP API, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it exposes any API surface that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
